title: PASS: Perturbation augmented space group structure sampling for transferable Fe-O machine learning interatomic potential
title_zh: PASS ：用于可转移Fe-O机器学习原子间势的扰动增强空间群结构采样
summary: 铁（ Fe ）氧化是一种具有科学重要性和技术意义的基本现象。尽管付出了大量的实验努力，但铁氧化的准确原子模型仍然难以捉摸，这需要可靠的原子间电位，其发展取决于具有代表性的第一原理训练数据集。然而， Fe-oxygen (O)系统以其结构复杂性而闻名，这使得生成高质量的第一原理数据集具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了扰动增强空间群结构采样（ PASS ）方法，为由小细胞结构（不超过10个原子）组成的Fe-O系统生成广泛的数据集。
abstract: arXiv:2607.28000v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Iron (Fe) oxidation is a fundamental phenomenon that is scientifically vital and technologically significant. Despite substantial experimental efforts, accurate atomistic modelling of Fe oxidation remains elusive, which requires a reliable interatomic potential, whose development hinges on a representative first-principles training dataset. However, Fe-oxygen (O) system is known for its structural complexity, rendering the generation of high-quality first-principles dataset challenging. In this work, we propose the Perturbation Augmented Space group structure Sampling (PASS) method to generate extensive dataset for Fe-O system consisting of small-cell structures (no more than 10 atoms). Based on atomic cluster expansion (ACE) framework, we present a systematic approach to developing a transferable machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP). The accuracy and capability of the ACE potential are thoroughly validated across pure Fe and Fe-O systems through bulk, surface, and interface properties. The large-scale Fe oxidation simulations with the ACE potential capture key features of the oxidation process, including the formation of an FeO-like structure consistent with recent experimental observations. This work demonstrates that the PASS method yields an accurate and transferable MLIP that can capture the reactive complexity of oxide growth while remaining computationally practical for extended systems.

title: A Hybrid Message-Passing and Electric-Field Representation for Electrostatic QM/MM Embedding with Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: 一种具有机器学习原子间电位的静电QM/MM嵌入的混合消息传递和电场表示
summary: 在混合量子力学/分子力学方法中，大原子系统的一个小区域被量子力学描述，而系统的其余部分由经典力场表示。尽管如此，量子计算的计算成本严重限制了可访问的模拟和采样时间。用在量子参考数据上训练的机器学习原子间势（ MLIP ）取代量子计算可以大大增加可访问的模拟时间。然而，准确性和效率在很大程度上取决于MLIP整合有关经典（静电）环境信息的具体方式。在这里，我们证明了纯粹基于外部电场特征的现有策略无法区分某些环境，最终限制了它们的准确性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.41523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Within a hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics approach a small region of a large atomistic system is described quantum mechanically, while the rest of the system is represented by a classical force field. Despite this, the computational cost of the quantum calculation severely limits the accessible simulation and sampling time. Replacing the quantum calculation with a machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) trained on quantum reference data can greatly increase the accessible simulation time. However, the accuracy and efficiency strongly depend on the specific way in which the MLIP incorporates information about the classical (electrostatic) environment. Here, we demonstrate that existing strategies based purely on features derived from an external electric field fail to distinguish certain environments, ultimately limiting their accuracy. As a solution, we propose an extension to the equivariant TensorNet architecture that mitigates this shortcoming by incorporating classical atoms close to the quantum region into the message-passing scheme, combined with features derived from the electric field for describing the environment farther away. We show that this combination achieves higher accuracy than either approach alone.

title: Electronic-Structure-Informed Many-Body Encoding for Quantum Machine Learning
title_zh: 用于量子机器学习的电子结构知情多体编码
summary: 数据编码是量子机器学习（ QML ）的核心挑战，因为它决定了经典信息如何映射到量子态，并影响参数化量子电路的表达能力和效率。在这里，我们引入了一种基于物理学的量子编码策略，该策略利用电子系统固有的多体结构来建立输入描述符的体序与量子门的局部性之间的直接对应关系。具体地说，从单个均值场电子结构计算中获得的n体电子描述符通过n量子比特门进行编码，从而产生具有增加的多体表达率的量子电路的系统层次结构。
abstract: arXiv:2610.40840v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Data encoding is a central challenge in quantum machine learning (QML), as it determines how classical information is mapped onto quantum states and influences the expressive power and efficiency of parameterized quantum circuits. Here, we introduce a physics-informed quantum encoding strategy that exploits the intrinsic many-body structure of electronic systems to establish a direct correspondence between the body order of input descriptors and the locality of quantum gates. Specifically, n-body electronic descriptors obtained from a single mean-field electronic-structure calculation are encoded through n-qubit gates, yielding a systematic hierarchy of quantum circuits with increasing many-body expressivity. Using reduced-density-matrix descriptors, we construct quantum machine-learning models incorporating one- through four-body encodings and benchmark their performance in predicting electron-correlation energies along bond-stretching potential energy surfaces. We demonstrate that increasing the body order of the encoding systematically improves prediction accuracy toward the full configuration interaction limit. Remarkably, disconnected many-particle densities constructed from lower-order electronic information achieve accuracy comparable to explicitly correlated two-particle densities in key cases, providing a computationally inexpensive route to higher-body quantum encodings. These findings establish a connection between the many-body structure of classical data and the design of quantum feature maps, offering a systematic, physically interpretable framework for enhancing the expressivity and predictive performance of quantum machine-learning circuits.

title: Oxidation-dependent mechanical response of graphene oxide: Improving the reliability of atomistic modeling by ab initio machine learning simulations
title_zh: 氧化石墨烯的氧化依赖性机械响应：通过从头开始的机器学习模拟提高原子学建模的可靠性
summary: 作者： Sara Shahbazi Fashtali、Pablo M. Piaggi和Giuseppe Zollo氧化石墨烯（ GO ）的机械响应受氧化水平和官能团组成的控制，但由于经典反应力场的限制，清晰的原子水平图仍然模糊不清。在这里，我们通过微调MACE来开发机器学习的原子间潜力… [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 113601] 2026年11月2日周一发布
abstract: Author(s): Sara Shahbazi Fashtali, Pablo M. Piaggi, and Giuseppe Zollo The mechanical response of graphene oxide (GO) is controlled by oxidation level and functional group composition, yet a clear atomic level picture remains ambiguous due to limitations of classical reactive force fields. Here, we develop a machine learning interatomic potential by fine-tuning a MACE … [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 113601] Published Mon Nov 02, 2026

title: Proof-Carrying Materials: Falsifiable Safety Certificates for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: 携带证明材料：机器学习的原子间电位的可伪造安全证书
summary: 机器学习的原子间势（ MLIP ）用于高通量材料筛选，没有正式的可靠性保证。我们表明，在25,000材料基准上，用作稳定性滤波器的单个MLIP错过了密度泛函理论（ DFT ）稳定材料的93 ％ （召回0.07 ）。证明材料（ PCM ）通过三个阶段弥补了这一差距：组成空间的对抗性伪造，具有95 ％置信区间的自举信封细化，以及精益4正式认证。
abstract: arXiv:2603.12183v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are deployed for high-throughput materials screening without formal reliability guarantees. We show that a single MLIP used as a stability filter misses 93% of density functional theory (DFT)-stable materials (recall 0.07) on a 25,000-material benchmark. Proof-Carrying Materials (PCM) closes this gap through three stages: adversarial falsification across compositional space, bootstrap envelope refinement with 95% confidence intervals, and Lean 4 formal certification. Auditing CHGNet, TensorNet and MACE reveals architecture-specific blind spots with near-zero pairwise error correlations (r <= 0.13; n = 5,000), confirmed by independent Quantum ESPRESSO validation (20/20 converged; median DFT/CHGNet force ratio 12x). A risk model trained on PCM-discovered features predicts failures on unseen materials (AUC-ROC = 0.938 +/- 0.004) and transfers across architectures (cross-MLIP AUC-ROC ~ 0.70; feature importance r = 0.877). In a thermoelectric screening case study, PCM-audited protocols discover 62 additional stable materials missed by single-MLIP screening - a 25% improvement in discovery yield.

title: Machine-learning-assisted tracking of magnetic objects using quantum diamond magnetometry
title_zh: 使用量子金刚石磁强计对磁性物体进行机器学习辅助跟踪
summary: 作者： Fernando Meneses、Christopher T.-K. Lew、Anand Sivamalai、Andy Sayers、Brant C. Gibson、Andrew D. Greentree、Lloyd C. L. Hollenberg和David A. Simpson远程磁跟踪对于GPS拒绝环境中的导航至关重要，但现实世界的信号往往过于微弱、嘈杂和复杂，无法可靠地建模。
abstract: Author(s): Fernando Meneses, Christopher T.-K. Lew, Anand Sivamalai, Andy Sayers, Brant C. Gibson, Andrew D. Greentree, Lloyd C. L. Hollenberg, and David A. Simpson Remote magnetic tracking is crucial for navigation in GPS-denied environments, but real-world signals are often too weak, noisy, and complex to model reliably. The authors combine quantum diamond magnetometry with a deep-learning algorithm trained solely on experimental data to track an elevator in an urban setting. They show that full-vector magnetic inputs over short time windows yield robust centimeter-scale accuracy across arbitrary sensor frames despite strong noise, with model training requiring less than an hour. This model-free approach provides a practical route to deploying quantum magnetometry for real-time tracking in complex environments. [Phys. Rev. Applied 26, 054003] Published Mon Nov 02, 2026

title: Towards Out-of-Distribution Uncertainty Quantification for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials via Pre-Training
title_zh: 通过预训练实现机器学习的原子间电位的非分布不确定性量化
summary: 信息不确定性量化（ UQ ）对于机器学习原子间势（ MLIP ）的实际部署至关重要，因为它提供了对其在化学空间中可靠性的洞察。尽管最近为MLIP提出了许多事后不确定性估计方法，但大多数方法都是在低数据体制下训练的，限制了它们对狭窄感兴趣领域的适用性。受到基础MLIP的出现的启发，我们提出在大型、多样化的数据集上预训练不确定性估计器，以实现更广泛的适用性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.41801v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Informative uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for the practical deployment of machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs), as it provides insight into their reliability across chemical space. Although numerous post-hoc uncertainty estimation methods for MLIPs have recently been proposed, most have been trained in low-data regimes, restricting their applicability to narrow domains of interest. Inspired by the emergence of foundational MLIPs, we propose pre-training uncertainty estimators on large, diverse datasets to enable broader applicability. We pre-train several UQ models on large materials science datasets to quantify the uncertainty of different MLIPs, and evaluate their performance on both in-distribution and out-of-domain (OOD) adsorption-energy predictions. We find that pre-trained uncertainty estimators provide viable zero-shot uncertainty estimates across multiple datasets, while fine-tuning consistently yields positive correlations between predicted uncertainty and prediction error, even on the most challenging datasets. These results lay the groundwork for foundational UQ models for MLIPs, ultimately facilitating their deployment in practical settings by providing users with a priori information about model reliability and applicability.

title: Generative Design and Graph Neural Network Screening of Novel Bimetallic Alloy Catalysts for the Hydrogen Evolution Reaction
title_zh: 用于氢进化反应的新型双金属合金催化剂的生成设计和图形神经网络筛选
summary: 在可扩展的绿色氢气生产中，识别用于氢气演化反应（ HER ）的地球丰富催化剂是一项核心挑战。我们提出了一种计算流水线，将基于扩散的生成模型、机器学习力场弛豫和图形神经网络（ GNN ）属性预测相结合，以发现现有吸附数据库所涵盖的结构和化学计量之外的双金属SHER催化剂。生成模型（ MatterGen ）在标记有最小氢吸附能量的散装合金结构上进行微调，并朝向接近零的吸附能量。
abstract: arXiv:2610.41932v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identifying earth-abundant catalysts for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) is a central challenge in scalable green hydrogen production. We present a computational pipeline that couples diffusion-based generative modelling, machine-learning force-field relaxation, and graph neural network (GNN) property prediction to discover bimetallic HER catalysts beyond the structures and stoichiometries covered by existing adsorption databases. A generative model (MatterGen) is fine-tuned on bulk alloy structures labelled with their minimum hydrogen adsorption energy and steered towards adsorption energies near zero. From the generated pool we retain the stable structures that are novel bimetallic alloys: binary compositions built from the training-set metals but at stoichiometries or structures absent from that database. Each candidate's low-index facets are ranked by a machine-learning-force-field (MatterSim) surface-energy screen, and only the most stable terminations are converted into explicit slab models with hydrogen adsorbed at all high-symmetry surface sites and relaxed with the same force field. Two GNN surrogates (MEGNet and ALIGNN), trained on a high-throughput density functional theory (DFT) dataset, then screen the resulting slab candidates. Because the two models encode the local environment through different inductive biases, we retain only the alloys on which both agree, reducing the influence of any single model. This consensus screening, combined with a MatterSim energy-difference triangulation, resulted in a shortlist of near-thermoneutral bimetallic candidates. Eight are validated with plane-wave DFT, and four of them, Pd5Au, Pt5Rh, Cu5Pt3, and Pd13Ru3, bind hydrogen within the thermoneutral window. All eight alloys are dynamically stable by phonon calculations. These four alloys are highlighted as DFT-validated bimetallic HER candidates for experimental follow-up.

title: Learning Nonlocal Interactions in Large-Scale Heterogeneous Metamaterials through Scientific Machine Learning
title_zh: 通过科学机器学习在大规模异构超材料中学习非局部交互
summary: 在多尺度系统中，空间分布成分之间的非局部相互作用可以解锁不可简化为单个成分反应的集体潜在突发行为。除了表征之外，多尺度系统中的非局部性越来越被视为断裂力学、波动物理和无序系统中的设计元素。现有的非局部性理论提供了严格的描述和机械洞察力，但通常需要规定的分析形式、范围、对称性或周期性。机器学习为学习交互提供了数据驱动的途径，但将网络设计与物理理论联系起来的原则性方法仍处于萌芽阶段。
abstract: arXiv:2610.41887v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In multiscale systems, nonlocal interactions among spatially distributed constituents can unlock collective, potentially emergent behavior irreducible to individual constituent responses. Beyond characterization, nonlocality in multiscale systems is increasingly viewed as a design element across fracture mechanics, wave physics, and disordered systems. Existing nonlocality theories provide rigorous descriptions and mechanistic insight, but often require prescribed analytic forms, range, symmetries, or periodicity. Machine learning offers a data-driven route to learn interactions, yet principled approaches that tie the network design to physical theory remain nascent. Here we present domain-decomposition attention neural operator (DANO), which learns configuration-dependent interactions in heterogeneous systems governed by linear field equations from field data alone. Through a case study in large-scale optical metasurfaces, we demonstrate DANO's full-field prediction under geometric heterogeneity and across drive conditions, small-to-large domain transfer, and multifunctional inverse design, with learned interactions validated through physics-based interrogation. As an AI-for-Science tool, it supports interaction discovery and scalable, customizable design of nonlocal multiscale systems, including virtual-reality optics.

title: Quantum 3xplorer: AI-Native Engine for Next-Generation Quantum Materials Modeling
title_zh: Quantum 3xplorer：用于下一代量子材料建模的 AI 原生引擎
summary: 密度泛函理论 (DFT) 等量子力学方法是现代计算材料科学的基础，也是人工智能驱动发现的主要数据来源。然而，当今已建立的电子结构代码代表了几十年前的软件架构，使得新的物理模型在新兴硬件上实施、验证和部署速度缓慢且成本高昂。我们推出了 Quantum 3xplorer（Q3，发音为“Quantum Explorer”），这是一种 AI 原生量子模拟引擎，由 AI 编码代理在领域科学家的指导和监督下从头开始编写。
abstract: arXiv:2610.42108v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum-mechanical approaches, such as density functional theory (DFT), underpin much of modern computational materials science and are the primary source of data for AI-driven discovery. Yet the established electronic-structure codes today represent decades-old software architectures, making new physical models slow and costly to implement, validate, and deploy on emerging hardware. We present Quantum 3xplorer (Q3, pronounced "Quantum Explorer"), an AI-native quantum simulation engine written from scratch by AI coding agents under the direction and supervision of domain scientists. As a first and demanding validation case, we implement plane-wave pseudopotential DFT end to end: norm-conserving, ultrasoft, and projector-augmented-wave formalisms, spin polarization, DFT+U, and dispersion corrections, together with forces, stresses, structural relaxation, and electronic-structure analysis. Q3 reproduces established reference implementations, runs faster on a single core in representative benchmarks, and scales across GPU-accelerated supercomputers. It was developed in weeks rather than years. Its layered, physics-first architecture separates abstract quantum-mechanical concepts from their numerical representations, making its framework extendable beyond plane waves to other basis sets and levels of theory. Its inputs and outputs follow structured, schema-validated data standards, making every result AI-ready. Q3 is open source under Apache 2.0 and built to be reused, extended, and improved by the research community. Q3 points to a paradigm shift in how computational quantum science is done. Scientists define the physics, formulate the models, and set the criteria for validation; AI agents write, test, and optimize the code. The decades-long path from a new theory to a trusted, high-performance implementation can thus collapse to days, significantly accelerating scientific discovery.

title: Magnetic control of reflectionless states and an intrinsic-mode exceptional point in a magnon-phonon coupling system
title_zh: 磁强子-声子耦合系统中无反射状态的磁控和固有模式的特殊点
summary: 无反射状态（ RL ）和异常点（ EP ）是非埃尔米特系统的标志性奇异响应，在传感、波控和能量操纵方面具有潜在的应用。然而，在紧凑的集成平台中实现和独立调节这些状态仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们演示了基于FeGaB-32度-YX-LiNbO3异质结构的片上倍频声子系统中RL和EP的二维磁控。磁场幅度调谐磁振子失调，驱动实频轴上的低损耗反射零，并产生两个具有近乎消失反射的场可调谐RL。实验测量的复合体S11围绕反射零奇点的闭合轮廓累积了-2pi相位绕组。
abstract: arXiv:2610.41851v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reflectionless states (RLs) and exceptional points (EPs) are hallmark singular responses of non-Hermitian systems, with potential applications in sensing, wave control, and energy manipulation. Yet, realizing and independently tuning these states in a compact integrated platform remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate two-dimensional magnetic control of RLs and EPs in an on-chip magnon-phonon system based on a FeGaB-32 degree-YX-LiNbO3 heterostructure. The magnetic-field magnitude tunes the magnon-phonon detuning, driving a low-loss reflection zero across the real-frequency axis and producing two field-tunable RLs with near-vanishing reflection. A closed contour of the experimentally measured complex S11 around the reflection-zero singularity accumulates a -2pi phase winding. Independently, rotating the magnetic field tunes the magnon-phonon coupling strength, driving the intrinsic magnon-phonon eigenmode spectrum across an exceptional point, identified by the exchange between real-part and imaginary-part eigenvalue splitting. A unified one-port input-output model connects the measured complex S11 response to the field-driven dynamics of the reflection zeros and the angle-tuned intrinsic magnon-phonon eigenmodes. These results establish a magnetically programmable non-Hermitian magnon-phonon platform for integrated wave control and compact vector magnetic sensing.

title: ORCHID: Connecting Finite-Temperature Thermodynamic Evidence to Computational Materials Discovery
title_zh: ORCHID：将有限温度热力学证据与计算材料发现联系起来
summary: 有限温度相稳定性对于材料发现至关重要，但描述它所需的证据仍然分散在数十年的文献中。 ORCHID 使用由热力学规则、专家监督和显式验证指导的分层代理提取，围绕观察描述的热力学状态组织这些证据。该集合包含来自 1,321 篇论文的 73,542 个值，以热力学状态、相特性、出处、证据类别和不确定性表示，以及评估的相组合和计算的参考值。合格的子集以 ESPEI 兼容的形式发布，用于 CALPHAD 评估，机器可读的访问支持人工和人工智能辅助的重用。
abstract: arXiv:2610.41164v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Finite-temperature phase stability is essential to materials discovery, but the evidence needed to describe it remains scattered across decades of literature. ORCHID organizes this evidence around the thermodynamic states that the observations describe, using tiered agentic extraction guided by thermodynamic rules, expert supervision and explicit validation. The collection contains 73,542 values from 1,321 papers, represented with their thermodynamic states, phase identities, provenance, evidence classes and uncertainty, together with assessed phase assemblages and calculated references. A qualified subset is released in ESPEI-compatible form for CALPHAD assessment, and machine-readable access supports both human and AI-assisted reuse. Blind expert evaluation of 48 diagram fields gives 93.8% agreement, increasing to 97.9% after accounting for notation conventions. On a common formation-enthalpy benchmark, eight MLIPs show residual spreads close to their DFT reference, motivating evaluation of finite-temperature phase stability through PhaseForge. One-shot MLIP-PhaseForge descriptions of Cu-Zr recover 0.35-0.56 of observed phase occurrences at assessed field points. ORCHID-assisted refinement through PhaseForge+ recovers 9 of 13 invariant temperatures within 2 sigma and reduces held-out activity error from 5.1 to 1.7 kJ/mol. By supplying interpreted literature evidence directly to gradient-based refinement through PhaseForge+, ORCHID connects evidence recovery to programmatic CALPHAD assessment. With the initial description and fitting datasets prepared, the final Cu-Zr refinement completes in approximately 27 minutes, providing a foundation for continuously updated thermodynamic models and their use in materials discovery.

title: Machine learning surrogates for multi-geometry EDGE2D-EIRENE studies of MAST Upgrade
title_zh: MAST升级的多几何EDGE2D-EIRENE研究的机器学习替代品
summary: 二维边缘等离子体传输模拟提供了转向器等离子体行为的详细描述，但其计算成本限制了大参数扫描和迭代建模。我们提供了一个包含23,379个融合EDGE2D-EIRENE模拟MAST升级（ MAST-U ）的数据库，涵盖三个转向器磁性配置、分离基体密度和输入功率的变化、氘燃料加注位置以及氮气播种速率和位置。独立的多层感知机代理被训练为12个标量输出，包括偏转器前部位置、目标电子温度和核心-边缘边界量。
abstract: arXiv:2610.41756v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional edge plasma transport simulations provide a detailed description of divertor plasma behaviour, but their computational cost limits large parameter scans and iterative modelling. We present a database of 23,379 converged EDGE2D-EIRENE simulations for MAST Upgrade (MAST-U), spanning three divertor magnetic configurations, variations in separatrix density and input power, deuterium fuelling locations, and nitrogen seeding rates and locations. Independent multilayer perceptron surrogates are trained for twelve scalar outputs, including divertor front positions, target electron temperature and core-edge boundary quantities. On a held-out test set, the surrogates achieve 0.9462 ≤ R² ≤ 0.9994, substantially outperforming linear regression baselines. Dense surrogate scans quantify the dependence of carbon radiation front motion on separatrix density, divertor geometry and fuelling location. Nitrogen seeding scans reveal a strong dependence on seeding location, with high-field-side seeding rapidly reducing core-boundary electron temperature, while divertor seeding produces little response. Batch inference for all twelve outputs at 786,432 operating points takes 1.76 s on GPU, compared with a median wall time of 2.61 hours using four CPU cores for separate EDGE2D-EIRENE simulations. These models enable rapid comparison of geometry and source-location effects on divertor and core-boundary conditions within the sampled simulation domain.

title: NEVPT2 multiple spawning molecular dynamics simulations for uracil
title_zh: 尿嘧啶的NEVPT2多产卵分子动力学模拟
summary: The quasidegenerate n -electron valence state second-order perturbation theory (QD-NEVPT2) for complete active space reference wavefunctions has been implemented in the OpenMolcas package. The impleme…
abstract: The quasidegenerate n -electron valence state second-order perturbation theory (QD-NEVPT2) for complete active space reference wavefunctions has been implemented in the OpenMolcas package. The implementation utilizes the efficient formulation of Kollmar et al. for the electronic energy, which is extended here to the calculation of analytic derivatives. To demonstrate its utility, the method is applied to classical and non-adiabatic molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of uracil. The non-adiabatic MD simulations describe the ultrafast deactivation of the initially excited bright ππ * state through the S 2 /S 1 conical intersection, demonstrating the applicability of the method to photochemical processes. Furthermore, a machine learning-based analysis of the trajectory data extracts key geometrical parameters that are associated with the magnitude of the time-derivative coupling. These results highlight the effectiveness of this QD-NEVPT2 implementation for studying excited-state dynamics.
journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

title: Berry curvature quadrupole induced third-order anomalous Hall effect in altermagnetic KV₂Se₂O
title_zh: 贝里曲率四极杆在交变磁 KV2Se2O 中诱导三阶反常霍尔效应
summary: 交变磁体将补偿磁序与动量相关的自旋分裂相结合，为探索非线性量子几何输运提供了一个富含对称性的平台。在这里考虑的 d 波交变磁体中，反酉对称运算 TC₄z 强制执行动量积分贝里曲率消失，而反演对称则禁止有限贝里曲率偶极子。因此，贝里曲率四极杆 (BCQ) 可以对非线性霍尔响应做出贡献，缩放为 τ²，其中 τ 表示弛豫时间。我们推导出规范协变 Wannier 插值公式，该公式能够直接从第一原理 Wannier 紧束缚哈密顿量有效评估 BCQ。
abstract: arXiv:2610.41274v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, providing a symmetry-rich platform for exploring nonlinear quantum-geometric transport. In the d-wave altermagnet considered here, the antiunitary symmetry operation TC₄z enforces a vanishing momentum-integrated Berry curvature, while inversion symmetry forbids a finite Berry-curvature dipole. Consequently, the Berry curvature quadrupole (BCQ) can provide a contribution to the nonlinear Hall response, scaling as τ², where τ denotes the relaxation time. We derive a gauge-covariant Wannier interpolation formula that enables efficient evaluation of the BCQ directly from first-principles Wannier tight-binding Hamiltonians. Applying this framework to KV₂Se₂O, we calculate the momentum-space distribution of the BCQ and the associated chemical potential dependent nonlinear conductivity. The momentum-resolved analysis reveals that the dominant contribution originates from spin-orbit coupling induced avoided arossings, directly linking the gap structure to the sign-changing nonlinear response. Our work establishes a general first-principles route to higher-order quantum-geometric responses in altermagnets, opening avenues for exploring nonlinear Hall effects in next-generation spintronic and magnetoelectronic devices.

title: Quantum Monte-Carlo study of spin-valley ferromagnetism in rhombohedral graphene
title_zh: 菱形石墨烯自旋谷铁磁性的量子蒙特卡罗研究
summary: 最近双层和三层菱面体石墨烯的电容测量报告了高于居里温度的大磁熵，表明波动局部矩的形成。进一步的实验支持来自菱面体六层石墨烯的扫描隧道显微镜实验，该实验直接可视化了蜂窝状电子晶体顺序，该顺序在熔化前加热时增强，与波美兰丘克效应相关。受这些实验的启发，我们构建了四分之一金属和半金属相的自旋谷局部矩哈密顿量。我们从约束 Hartree-Fock 计算中提取它们的耦合，并使用随机级数展开量子蒙特卡罗求解它们的有限温度热力学。
abstract: arXiv:2610.40864v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent capacitance measurements in bilayer and trilayer rhombohedral graphene reported large magnetic entropy above the Curie temperature, suggesting the formation of fluctuating local moments. Further experimental support comes from scanning tunneling microscopy experiments in rhombohedral hexalayer graphene, which directly visualized honeycomb electron-crystal order that strengthens upon heating before melting, related to the Pomeranchuk effect. Motivated by these experiments, we construct spin-valley local-moment Hamiltonians for the quarter-metal and half-metal phases. We extract their couplings from constrained Hartree-Fock calculations, and solve their finite-temperature thermodynamics with stochastic-series-expansion quantum Monte Carlo. For the quarter metal we find a continuous 2D-Ising transition at T_c approx 0.7 K, an order of magnitude smaller than the Hartree-Fock estimate (~30 K) and closer to the experimental scale of a few kelvin. For the half metal, we study the field-induced magnetization as a function of temperature with and without proximity-enhanced spin-orbit coupling. When spin-orbit coupling is negligible, intervalley Hund's coupling enhances the magnetic response. Strong spin-orbit coupling, as can be induced by a neighboring transition-metal dichalcogenide, gives rise to the standard spin-canted ground state at zero temperature. Upon heating, the in-plane polarization decreases more rapidly than the out-of-plane polarization. Surprisingly, despite the itinerant nature of the electrons, local-moment models with microscopically determined couplings appear to capture key finite-temperature magnetic properties of rhombohedral graphene without any fitting.

title: SKFitter: Symmetry resolved Slater Koster tight-binding models from first principles for s, p, d and f electrons, spin orbit coupling and magnetism
title_zh: SKFitter：根据 s、p、d 和 f 电子、自旋轨道耦合和磁性的第一原理，对称性解析了 Slater Koster 紧束缚模型
summary: 从第一原理计算构建准确且物理上可解释的紧束缚（TB）哈密顿量仍然具有挑战性，特别是对于表现出复杂轨道杂化、自旋轨道耦合（SOC）和磁序的材料。 SKFitter 是一个开源 Python 框架，用于直接根据使用 Quantum ESPRESSO 或 VASP 执行的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算构建和优化对称解析的 Slater Koster TB 模型。该框架支持 s 到 f 轨道，结合了现场 SOC 和现场解决的磁交换相互作用，并适应正交和非正交基础。
abstract: arXiv:2610.40729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Constructing accurate and physically interpretable tight binding (TB) Hamiltonians from first principles calculations remains challenging, particularly for materials exhibiting complex orbital hybridization, spin orbit coupling (SOC), and magnetic order. SKFitter is an open-source Python framework for constructing and optimizing symmetry resolved Slater Koster TB models directly from density functional theory (DFT) calculations performed using Quantum ESPRESSO or VASP. The framework supports s to f orbitals, incorporates on site SOC and site resolved magnetic exchange interactions, and accommodates both orthogonal and nonorthogonal basis. A central feature is the symmetry resolved parameterization of orbital manifolds, which allows independent two centre hopping integrals between symmetry allowed orbital groups and across distinct neighbour shells. SKFitter also identifies missing orbital contributions and guide systematic basis set refinement and optimizes parameters through weights. The resulting Hamiltonian can be used to evaluate anomalous (AHC) and spin Hall conductivities (SHC), and topological invariants. We demonstrate the framework using eight representative materials spanning semimetals, semiconductors, transition metals, f-electron compounds, and magnetic systems. Symmetry resolved models achieve band energy errors of 9 to 41 meV within 1 eV of the Fermi level. The fitted Hamiltonians reproduce characteristic features of the SHC response of Pt, the SOC dependence of the AHC of Fe, and the momentum dependent altermagnetic spin splitting of MnTe without any altermagnet specific interaction. For EuMn2Bi2, projection guided orbital refinement reduces the near Fermi level fitting error from 120 to 32 meV. Together, these results establish SKFitter as a flexible and reproducible framework for developing symmetry consistent, physically interpretable TB models of complex materials.

title: A Universal Approach to Hydrodynamics in Higher Dimensions via Tensor Networks
title_zh: 通过张量网络实现高维流体动力学的通用方法
summary: 直接从微观量子模型中提取后期流体动力输运特性，特别是在一维以上的模型中，被认为是经典的难题。这在一定程度上归因于更高维度中纠缠的广泛增长以及几何和张量网络局部性之间的不匹配。在这里，我们扩展了密度矩阵截断（DMT）算法，以准确定量地预测最多三个维度的高温传输系数（例如扩散常数）。此外，我们还展示了捕获弱破坏可积性的缓慢交叉动态特征的能力。我们方法的直觉是在整个时间演化过程中保留对流体动力学至关重要的几何局部信息，尽管使用一维矩阵乘积状态 ansatz 进行高维计算。
abstract: arXiv:2610.40776v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Extracting late-time hydrodynamic transport properties directly from microscopic quantum models, especially in dimensions beyond one, is believed to be classically intractable. This owes, in part, to the extensive growth of entanglement in higher dimensions and often a mismatch between geometric and tensor network locality. Here, we extend the Density Matrix Truncation (DMT) algorithm to accurately and quantitatively predict high-temperature transport coefficients (e.g. diffusion constants) in up to three dimensions. Additionally, we demonstrate the ability to capture the slow crossover dynamics characteristic of weakly broken integrability. The intuition underlying our approach is to preserve the geometrically local information crucial for hydrodynamics throughout the time evolution, despite using a one-dimensional matrix product state ansatz for higher-dimensional calculations. Our work pushes the boundary of classical computability and opens the door to benchmarking the high-temperature, late-time dynamics of generic quantum simulators.

title: Anisotropic Boltzmann transport in a tight-binding superlattice: Exact results for power-law energy-dependent scattering
title_zh: 文献研究：Anisotropic Boltzmann transport in a tight-binding superlattice: Exact results for power-law energy-dependent scattering
summary: We develop a complete Boltzmann transport theory for the in-plane (σₓₓ) and out-of-plane (σzz) conductivities of an electronic superlattice consisting of a periodic stack of two-dimensional (2D) parab…
abstract: arXiv:2610.41101v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a complete Boltzmann transport theory for the in-plane (σₓₓ) and out-of-plane (σzz) conductivities of an electronic superlattice consisting of a periodic stack of two-dimensional (2D) parabolic-band layers coupled along the superlattice axis by nearest-neighbor tunneling t, in the physically relevant regime tll E_F where the Fermi surface is an open, corrugated cylinder. Within the relaxation-time approximation with a power-law energy-dependent scattering time τ(E)propto Ep, we study the seven models p=0,±1,±3/2,±2 as functions of the 2D electron density n per layer and temperature T. For p=-2 (in plane) and ple -1 (out of plane), long-lived carriers at the miniband bottom can dominate transport at finite temperature. For p=-2, these carriers produce a pronounced peak in σzz(T) at Tsim E_F. We find that the temperature dependence of the anisotropic metallic dc conductivity can be highly counterintuitive depending on t, T, and p, with no generic increase or decrease with temperature. The Lorenz ratio is determined by the energy variance of the current-carrying electrons; the Wiedemann-Franz (WF) law is exact as T→0 for all models at fixed t, with anisotropic corrections at finite temperature. Band-edge carriers first enhance the interlayer Lorenz ratio up to several times its low-temperature value through thermal occupation of separated energy ranges within the same electron band and then suppress it at high temperature by energy filtering. Strong violations of the Wiedemann-Franz law can therefore arise from miniband structure and energy-dependent elastic scattering alone.

title: Anisotropic spin splitting in α-MnTe epilayers on InP(111)A and Si(111) substrates
title_zh: InP(111)A 和 Si(111) 衬底上 α-MnTe 外延层的各向异性自旋分裂
summary: α-MnTe 已成为一种典型的变磁材料，它将补偿反铁磁序与动量相关的自旋分裂相结合。在这里，我们研究了在 InP(111)A 和 Si(111) 衬底上通过分子束外延生长的外延 α-MnTe 层的结构和电子特性。通过反射高能电子衍射 (RHEED)、原子力显微镜 (AFM) 和 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 表征外延层的晶体和表面质量，证实形成了高质量的单相薄膜。进行了输运测量，证实了反铁磁转变和弱铁磁性。使用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）研究电子结构。
abstract: arXiv:2610.40850v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: α-MnTe has emerged as a prototypical altermagnetic material, combining compensated antiferromagnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting. Here, we investigate the structural and electronic properties of epitaxial α-MnTe layers grown by molecular beam epitaxy on InP(111)A and Si(111) substrates. The crystalline and surface quality of the epilayers was characterised by reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED), atomic force microscopy (AFM), and X-ray diffraction (XRD), confirming the formation of high-quality, single-phase films. The transport measurements were performed, confirming an antiferromagnetic transition and weak ferromagnetism. The electronic structure was studied using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES). At 90 K, both samples exhibit relativistic anisotropic valence band splitting, which is substantially larger along the Γ-K direction, reaching approximately 300 meV, than along Γ-M, where values of about 150~meV are observed. The magnitude and momentum dependence of the splitting are very similar for α-MnTe grown on the two different substrates, indicating the robustness of the altermagnetic electronic structure with respect to the epitaxial environment.
